description: This file contains unit tests for the absl::random_internal::randen_engine, including tests for reseeding, serialization, interface compliance, golden value checks, and performance timing.

classes.name: RandenEngineTypedTest
classes.description: Template test fixture for randen_engine with various unsigned integer types.

methods.name: VerifyReseedChangesAllValues
methods.description: Tests that reseeding the engine with different seed sequences changes the output values.

methods.name: VerifyDiscard
methods.description: Tests the discard functionality of the engine to ensure it produces consistent sequences after discarding.

methods.name: StreamOperatorsResult
methods.description: Checks that streaming operators for the engine work correctly.

methods.name: StreamSerialization
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of the engine state.

methods.name: RandomNumberEngineInterface
methods.description: Verifies that the engine meets the C++ random number engine interface requirements.

methods.name: RandenEngineSFINAETest
methods.description: Tests SFINAE constraints and type traits for the engine.

methods.name: VerifyGoldenRanden64Default
methods.description: Checks that the engine produces expected golden output values for default seed.

methods.name: VerifyGoldenRanden64Seeded
methods.description: Checks that the seeded engine produces expected golden output values.

methods.name: VerifyGoldenRanden32Default
methods.description: Checks golden output for 32-bit engine with default seed.

methods.name: VerifyGoldenRanden32Seeded
methods.description: Checks golden output for 32-bit engine with seed.

methods.name: VerifyGoldenFromDeserializedEngine
methods.description: Verifies that deserialized engine produces the same sequence as the original.

methods.name: IsFastOrSlow
methods.description: Measures the performance of the engine to distinguish fast and slow paths.
